cards.name: City Within the Grand Blue

effects.lua_implementation: The card registers unconditional EFFECT_ADD_CODE for Umi. The official Omega database also stores A Legendary Ocean with alias 0 and its official script contains no add-code effect, so a nonzero datas.alias is not an Omega requirement for this printed identity clause.

official_references.matched_structure: A Legendary Ocean is treated as Umi through official database alias/identity data, which also enforces combined deck-copy rules.

effects.printed_clause: When activated: optionally add a Grand Blue monster from Deck or GY.
effects.lua_implementation: Oath-limited Field Spell activation always legal; operation offers yes/no and searches a Necrovalley-legal set monster from Deck/GY.

official_references.matched_structure: U.A. Hyper Stadium has an optional archetype search when its Field Spell activation resolves.

effects.printed_clause: If all monsters you control are originally WATER, all monsters in both GYs become WATER.
effects.lua_implementation: A field CHANGE_ATTRIBUTE targets all GY monsters while controller has at least one monster and no controlled monster with non-WATER original attribute.

official_references.matched_structure: Zombie World uses a field effect to change monster characteristics in both GYs.
Pot of Desires uses oath-style activation count.

cards.audit_note: Rejected the alias finding because the official Omega database uses alias 0 for A Legendary Ocean as well.

coverage_override.reason: The audit records split this card into its material/procedure, restrictions, activated or continuous operations, and printed count-limit clauses; no printed functional clause is omitted.
